# Styled Tools
Have you ever wished that wooden tools came in all of the wood variants? Well, this datapack does exactly that!

### What this datapack adds
<details>
  <summary>Pickaxes (Items)</summary>
  
  - Oak Pickaxe
  - Spruce Pickaxe
  - Birch Pickaxe
  - Jungle Pickaxe
  - Acacia Pickaxe
  - Dark Oak Pickaxe
  - Mangrove Pickaxe
  - Crimson Pickaxe
  - Warped Pickaxe
</details>
<details>
  <summary>Axes (Items)</summary>

  - Mangrove Axe

  - Warped Axe
</details>

<details>
